name: sarra-wallet
description: صُرّة — محفظة USDT غير احتجازية على شبكة TRON

scripts.vendor: mkdir -p src/vendor && cp node_modules/tronweb/dist/TronWeb.js src/vendor/tronweb.js && cp node_modules/qrcode-generator/qrcode.js src/vendor/qrcode.js && cp node_modules/jsqr/dist/jsQR.js src/vendor/jsqr.js && cp node_modules/ethers/dist/ethers.umd.min.js src/vendor/ethers.js && cp node_modules/lightweight-charts/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js src/vendor/lightweight-charts.js && npm run build
scripts.test: node test/core.test.mjs && node test/version.test.mjs && node test/format.test.mjs && node test/rxmatch.test.mjs && node test/indicators.test.mjs && node test/records.test.mjs && node test/registry.test.mjs && node test/evm-fees.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings test/p2p-logic.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings test/push-logic.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings test/monitor-logic.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings test/pay-logic.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings test/pay-app.test.ts
scripts.sync: npm run vendor && npm run config && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
